title.en: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF SAMAR SHALL NOT COME WITHIN THE PROVISIONS OF THE CIVIL SERVICE ACT UNTIL MARCH FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.orig: AN ACT PROVIDING THAT OFFICIALS AND EMPLOYEES OF THE PROVINCIAL GOVERNMENT OF SAMAR SHALL NOT COME WITHIN THE PROVISIONS OF THE CIVIL SERVICE ACT UNTIL MARCH FIRST, NINETEEN HUNDRED AND THREE.
title.vi: Đạo luật số 1 năm 1903 quy định rằng các quan chức và nhân viên chính quyền tỉnh Samar sẽ không thuộc phạm vi áp dụng của Đạo luật Dịch vụ Dân sự cho đến ngày 1 tháng 3 năm 1903

title.id: Undang-Undang Nomor 1 Tahun 1903 yang Menetapkan bahwa Pejabat dan Pegawai Pemerintah Provinsi Samar Tidak Termasuk dalam Ketentuan Undang-Undang Pegawai Negeri Sipil Sampai dengan 1 Maret 1903
title.ms: Akta Bilangan 1 Tahun 1903 yang Menetapkan Bahawa Pegawai dan Kakitangan Kerajaan Wilayah Samar Tidak Terkandung dalam Peruntukan Akta Perkhidmatan Awam sehingga 1 Mac 1903

text.en:
The provisions of the Provincial Government Act and its amendments, placing certain officials
and employees of provincial governments under the provisions of the Civil Service Act after March first,
nineteen hundred and two, shall not apply to the officials and employees of the provincial government of
Samar until March first, nineteen hundred and three.

The public good requiring the speedy enactment of this bill, the passage of the same is hereby
expedited in accordance with section two of "An Act prescribing the order of procedure by the Commission
in the enactment of laws," passed September twenty-sixth, nineteen hundred.

This Act shall take effect on its passage.
Enacted, July 23, 1902.
